lesson.uz:
Loyihani kichik bosqichlarga bo‘ling: ma’lumot olish, tekshirish, hisoblash va chiqarish. Avval oddiy misolni qog‘ozda yeching, so‘ng bloklarga aylantiring.
Kassa uchun yig‘indi, baholar uchun hisoblagich va o‘rtacha, ombor uchun shartli yangilash kerak bo‘ladi. Natijalar tartibi shart bilan aynan mos bo‘lsin. Loyihada menyu, qo‘shimcha matn yoki tasodifiy son kerak emas, agar shart so‘ramasa.
lesson.en:
Break a project into input, validation, calculation and output. Work through a small example on paper before drawing blocks.
A checkout needs totals, a grade book needs counters and averages, and stock tracking needs conditional updates. Match the specified output order. Do not add a menu, prompts or randomness unless requested.

text.uz: Shartdagi talab etilgan bloklarga e’tibor bering.
text.en: Check the required blocks in each task.

text.uz: Har bir Input alohida qatorni o‘qiydi. Natijani namuna bilan taqqoslang.
text.en: Each Input reads one line. Compare your output with the examples.

statement.uz: Maktab do‘koni: Har xarid qiymati berilgan. Jami summa va har 2 so‘m uchun 1 ball hisobida jami bonusni chiqaring.
statement.en: School shop: Given purchase amounts, print total spending and bonus points (1 per 2 units of total spending).

inputFormat.uz: n (0..100), keyin n ta butun miqdor (0..10000), har biri alohida qatorda.
inputFormat.en: n (0..100), then n integer quantities (0..10000), one per line.

outputFormat.uz: So‘ralgan natijalarni berilgan tartibda, har birini alohida qatorda chiqaring. Qo‘shimcha matn chiqarmang.
outputFormat.en: Print the requested results in order, one per line, with no extra text.

hints.uz: Kirishdagi qiymatlarni yozib oling va bitta namunani qo‘lda hisoblang.
hints.en: Name the input values and work through one example by hand.

hints.uz: Darsdagi blok tartibidan foydalaning. Natija qayerda yangilanishini aniqlang.
hints.en: Use the block order from the lesson. Identify where the result changes.

hints.uz: Eng kichik kirish qiymati va shart chegarasini alohida tekshiring. Keraksiz matn chiqarmang.
hints.en: Check the smallest valid input and condition boundaries. Avoid extra output text.
